name: STEM (Spatiotemporal Epidemiological Modeler)
description: Eclipse Foundation open-source spatiotemporal epidemiological modeling platform built on the Eclipse plugin architecture. Supports compartmental (SEIR/SIR), network-based, and agent-based epidemic models with geographic visualization across administrative boundaries. Designed to help researchers and public health professionals build, visualize, and analyze spatial epidemic models with temporal dynamics. Includes a library of predefined disease models and geographic datasets.
general_score_metric: scenario-based composite metrics (e.g., RMSE of predicted case counts, peak timing error, spatial prediction accuracy)
reputation: Established open-source platform from Eclipse Foundation; used in academic public health research
notes: Available from the Eclipse Foundation. Supports multiple disease transmission models including vector-borne diseases. Geographic data from UN administrative boundaries. Less active development post-2020.
